tail:
Completed batch 81 authoring. I added a local lemma proving that the unique action-value Bellman fixed point equals the maximal discounted return and is attained by a greedy stationary continuation. The Q-learning theorem now defines optimality through that return and depends on the lemma. The new lemma is level 4; the Q-learning theorem is level 5.

The optimality interface was checked against [Sutton and Barto §3.8](https://web.stanford.edu/class/psych209/Readings/SuttonBartoIPRLBook2ndEd.pdf) and [Brown CS-96-08 §2.2](https://cs.brown.edu/research/pubs/techreports/reports/96/cs96-08.pdf); the full proof is local. The pair has 17 items, and all 17 Step 1 records are closed `ready`, `owner:false`.

**Checks:** Proof layout, precheck, rendercheck, statement-first, content-policy, coverage, and strict proof-contract validation passed. The contract contains 115 supplier citations and 43 derivations. Source fetch verification passed for 4/4 sources. The run-wide dependency-level check reports 50 errors outside batch 81; batch 81 has none.

The full run remains open: the latest snapshot reports 989 items, 733 ready, and 17/17 batch 81 items ready. Autopilot remains at `1-scaffold`, with 61/101 pairs covered and an owner repair/recertification hold.

Key artifacts: [new lemma](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/lem-optimal-action-value-is-attained-by-greedy-policy.md>), [Q-learning theorem](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/items/thm-tabular-q-learning-convergence-under-robbins-monro-conditions.md>), [batch notes](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-81.notes.md>), [proof contracts](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-81.proof-contracts.json>), and [source evidence](</home/lazyinspirit/Projects/prestige-math-library/research/machine-learning-all-101-2026-10-19-batch-81.source-evidence.json>).
